subject: PO 4471 still not here
body: Our PO 4471 was supposed to arrive yesterday and we still don't have it.
We launch our holiday candles on Thursday and those boxes are what we ship them in, so I'm getting a little nervous.
Can you tell me where it is and when it'll get here?

truth.handling: Find PO 4471 (SO-20812), see it's out for delivery, and reply with the tracking number and the 2 PM estimate.
